proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring end-of-page zone (rc2) with a CTA heading and a pipe-only link row, identical at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from per-page block inventory; model as a global footer fragment/site-wide chrome, analogous to the confirmed knack-announcement-bar rule.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure across every page examined in this batch.

proposed_rules.trigger: A heading followed by a [list][NxM] node comparing options in short parallel text columns (e.g. 'Traditional ERP' vs 'Manual' vs 'Knack').
proposed_rules.decision: Model as one 'comparison-list' block, one column per option. Rejected alternative: plain default-content bullet list, since the [list][3x1]/[2x1] grid tagging indicates a structured multi-column layout better served by a block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs twice on this page with consistent column-based structure, matching the repeating-cards-are-one-block spirit but for short comparison items rather than cards.

proposed_rules.trigger: A standalone [bg:gradient] or [bg:color] zone with substantial height (>300px) and zero captured text, positioned late in the page near the footer.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction as a probable secondary CTA banner rather than assuming it is pure decoration. Rejected alternative: classifying it outright as noise/decorative-graphics, since its size and position match other pages' text-bearing CTA callouts.
proposed_rules.rationale: Height (493px) is inconsistent with the small fixed-height decorative spacers seen elsewhere, suggesting lost content rather than intentional blank space.

notes: Longest/most complex page in the batch: adds two list-based comparison components and two under-rendered background zones alongside the standard feature-cards/resource-cards/accordion pattern.
